edges.label: Green was CIA's monitor for the SRI psychoenergetics work
edges.note: Green served in CIA's Office of Scientific Intelligence, Life Sciences Division, and has stated he was the officer to whom anomalous-phenomena reporting was routed.

edges.label: Co-authors of the Nature paper and the SRI remote-viewing protocol
edges.note: Nature 251, 602-607 (18 October 1974); 'Standard Remote Viewing Protocol (Local Targets),' SRI, November 1978.

edges.label: Puthoff founded and led the SRI psychoenergetics programme
edges.note: CIA's Office of Technical Service funded the work from 1972; it was later sponsored by Army INSCOM and DIA under successive codenames.

edges.label: Targ was co-principal investigator at SRI 1972-1982
edges.note: Targ co-authored both the 1974 Nature paper and the November 1978 SRI remote-viewing protocol released in the STARGATE declassification.

title: R. Targ & H. Puthoff, 'Information transmission under conditions of sensory shielding', Nature 251, 602-607
